title: The Case of the Copper Whale
story: For as long as anyone can remember, a copper whale has swung on the boatyard roof. On Wednesday morning the roof was bare, and Felix called it the least shipshape thing he had ever seen. Five visitors were in the yard the evening before, each with a different tool and a different excuse. The roof is too high to reach without a ladder, and fresh ladder marks dent the frost under the eaves. Who took down the copper whale?

question.text: Who took down the copper whale?

texts: The visitor with the lantern is younger than the visitor with the ladder.
The visitor with the rope is older than the visitor with the ladder.
Of Milo and the visitor with the rope, one is 60 years old and the other is 40 years old.
The visitor with the fishing excuse is exactly 30 years older than the visitor with the sketching excuse.
The visitor with the fishing excuse is older than the visitor with the wrench.
Boris gave either the jogging or the sketching excuse.
Of Cass and the visitor with the fishing excuse, one is 20 years old and the other is 60 years old.
Jade gave neither the fishing nor the stargazing excuse.
Of the visitor with the jogging excuse and the 50-year-old, one is Arlo and the other is Cass.
